materials-safety: Not classified as hazardous under EU CLP rules. Components: steel service pipe, cured polyurethane foam insulation and HDPE outer casing. Safety documentation applies to production raw materials.
environment-emissions: Manufacturing emissions (A1–A3): 138 kg CO₂e/m. Operational emissions during normal use (B1–B7): none.
environment-carbon-footprint: 138 kg CO₂e/m for raw material extraction, transport and manufacturing (A1–A3)
environment-embodied-carbon: 138 kg CO₂e/m (A1–A3), cradle-to-gate; independently verified in the product EPD
environment-lifecycle: Third-party verified EPD available. Standards: EN 15804+A2 and ISO 14025. Scope: raw materials, manufacturing, installation, end-of-life processing and recycling benefits
environment-renewable-share: Manufactured using renewable electricity. Renewable primary energy represents approximately 9% of total primary energy demand (A1–A3).
circularity-recyclability-rate: Estimated 71% by mass, primarily through steel recycling
circularity-reusability: Direct reuse potential is low due to long-term infrastructure use. End-of-life value is mainly recovered through material recycling, particularly steel.
circularity-recyclable-content: Steel, HDPE casing and copper components are recyclable where suitable facilities are available
circularity-replaceable-parts: Foam, casing and joints can be repaired or replaced by Kingspan LOGSTOR. The steel service pipe may be repairable depending on its condition and the extent of damage.
circularity-repairability: Repairability is assessed case by case. Foam, casing and joints are repairable or replaceable. The steel service pipe may also be repaired depending on its condition and the extent of damage.
installation-instructions: Keep the product clean and dry before installation. Protect insulation and pipe ends from moisture, dirt and damage. Follow the manufacturer’s trench, bedding and backfilling requirements. Use suitable supports to prevent excessive bending stress.
installation-safety: Wear appropriate PPE and follow applicable health, safety and environmental rules. Handle chemicals, insulation and foaming agents in accordance with their Safety Data Sheets.
installation-handling: Transport and store carefully. Protect against impact, moisture and contamination.- Use suitable lifting equipment and follow manufacturer guidance. Recycle or dispose of materials under local regulations.
installation-storage: Store pipes without risk of damage. Place them on level, stone-free sand cushions at least 0.5 m wide, or on sleepers at least 100 mm wide and no more than 2 m apart. Align labels at the same end to support wire connection during installation.
installation-maintenance: No routine cleaning or maintenance is required under normal operating conditions. Perform inspections and maintenance according to local operating procedures and system requirements.
end-of-life-dismantling: Separate the service pipe, casing, insulation, metal components and surveillance wires. Segregate each fraction for reuse, recycling or energy recovery in accordance with local regulations and manufacturer guidance.
end-of-life-instructions: Remove the pipe and separate material fractions. Recycle steel through established recycling streams. Process HDPE casing and PUR foam according to local regulations and available recovery options.
end-of-life-recycling: Separate PUR foam, PE/HDPE casing, service pipes and surveillance wires. Recycle HDPE, steel, copper, aluminium, brass and suitable PE-RT components. Separate multilayer pipes before recycling. Treat electronic parts as e-waste. Incinerate PUR foam and cross-linked materials under controlled conditions. Reuse valves and chemicals where possible; otherwise dispose of them under applicable local rules.
end-of-life-disposal: Use authorized waste-management channels. Separate steel, HDPE and PUR components and process each fraction in accordance with local environmental regulations.
packaging-materials: Wooden supports, Material straps, Red end caps
